hero.title: Make your table look the way you want
hero.lead: Colors, fonts, rows, search, pagination and mobile layout, all in one panel with a live preview. Find a setting below, read what it changes, then open its full guide.

tasks.text: Split a long table into pages

branches.label: Table Design tab overview
branches.goal: The live preview and the panel around it.

nodes.label: Live preview options
nodes.changes: The preview shows the table the way visitors will see it.
nodes.visitors: Nothing: the preview is for you only.
facts: Preview Width: Desktop, Tablet and Mobile
Unsaved changes show in the preview until you save
nodes.ux: See every change before you save it.

branches.label: Colors
branches.goal: Set the color mood of the whole table in one click, or take full control.

nodes.label: Preset color schemes
nodes.changes: Recolors the search bar, header, rows, hover state and footer together with one of 14 ready-made schemes. The **Default** scheme adds no colors, so the table follows your theme.
nodes.visitors: The whole table in one consistent palette, with no per-color work from you.
facts: Default scheme follows your theme and style library
13 more schemes (Pro): White, Red, Orange, Yellow, Olive, Green, Teal, Blue, Violet, Purple, Pink, Grey, Black
nodes.ux: Recolor the whole table in one click.

nodes.label: Custom colors
nodes.changes: Lets you set the background, text and border of the search bar, header, body rows and footer one by one. You can also color odd and even rows differently.
nodes.visitors: Exactly your brand colors, including a different color for rows under the pointer.
facts: Search Bar Colors: Background, Icon, Border
Table Header Colors: Background, Text, Border
Table Body Colors: Background, Text, Border, plus a Hover state
Alternate Row Colors: separate Odd and Even rows
Pagination Colors: Background, Active Page, Border
nodes.ux: Match your brand to the exact color.

branches.label: Styling
branches.goal: Decide what sits above the table, which font it uses and how rows and borders look.

nodes.label: Title & Header
nodes.changes: Switches the table title, the description and the header row on or off above and inside the table.
nodes.visitors: A clean table with only the heading text you want shown.
facts: Show Table Title: off for new tables
Show Table Description: off for new tables
Hide Header Row: off by default
Text is edited in Table details
nodes.ux: Choose what sits above and inside the table.

nodes.label: Typography
nodes.changes: Changes the font family and the font size of the table text. The default, **Inherit From Theme**, copies your site font.
nodes.visitors: Text that matches your site, or stands out from it on purpose.
facts: Font Family: Inherit From Theme or a generic family, all free
Font Size: slider 1 to 50 px, default 14
nodes.ux: Make the table text match your site.

nodes.label: Rows & Borders
nodes.changes: Turns row stripes, hover highlight, borders and row spacing on or off. The options depend on the table engine and style library.
nodes.visitors: Rows that are easier to scan: zebra stripes, a highlighted row under the pointer, tighter or roomier cells.
facts: Groups: Rows, Borders, Layout
FooTable: Semantic UI, Bootstrap 4 or Bootstrap 3 library
Semantic UI only: Single Line Cells, Fixed Layout
DataTables: adds Hide All Borders, no library choice
nodes.ux: Stripes, hover and borders for rows that are easy to scan.

branches.label: Features
branches.goal: Decide what visitors can do with the table, and how it behaves on every screen.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.changes: Adds a search box above the table. Visitors type a word and only matching rows stay visible. You control its wording, and on Pro its position and colors.
nodes.visitors: A search box that filters rows as they type, and your own message when nothing matches.
facts: Turn on or off (on by default)
Texts: Placeholder, Empty Result, Dropdown Heading
Look: Position, Full Width (colors are in the Colors tab)
Leave a column out: turn off Searchable in column settings (Pro)
nodes.ux: Help visitors find the right row in seconds.

nodes.label: Sorting
nodes.changes: Lets visitors click a column heading to sort by it. **Default Order** sets the order rows appear in before anyone clicks.
nodes.visitors: Clickable headings, and a table that opens already ordered the way you chose.
facts: Sorting: on / off switch
Default Order: Created Date, By Column, Manual (Pro)
Order: Oldest First, Newest First
By Column: Column, Direction (A → Z, Z → A)
nodes.ux: Let visitors put rows in the order they need.

nodes.label: Pagination
nodes.changes: Splits a long table into pages instead of one long scroll. You set the rows per page and where the page numbers sit.
nodes.visitors: Page numbers under the table, with a limited number of rows at a time.
facts: Pagination: on / off switch
Rows Per Page: 20 by default
Let Visitors Change Page Size: Pro
Scroll To The Table Top On Page Change: Pro
Position: Left, Center, Right
Colors: Pagination Colors in the Colors tab
nodes.ux: Break a long table into easy pages.

nodes.label: Sticky Header & Column
nodes.changes: Pins the header row while visitors scroll down, and pins the first column while they scroll sideways.
nodes.visitors: Headings and row labels that never scroll out of view.
facts: Sticky Header: header pinned while the table scrolls
Top Offset: saved, not applied by the current engines
Turn Off On Mobile: screens 767px and narrower
Sticky First Column: stays put when scrolling sideways
nodes.ux: Keep headings in view while visitors scroll.

nodes.label: Responsive & Stackable Table
nodes.changes: Decides what a wide table does on a small screen. Columns can fold into a **+** drawer, rows can turn into cards, and a click can open the details of a row in a popup.
nodes.visitors: On phones, a table that fits the screen instead of forcing sideways scrolling.
facts: Responsive drawer: Closed, First Row (Pro), All Rows (Pro)
Toggle Position: First Column, Last Column
Enable Stackable Table: you pick the devices
Card Look: Hide Column Headings, Hide Internal Borders
nodes.ux: Make wide tables comfortable on phones.

nodes.label: Row Details Popup
nodes.changes: Makes every row clickable. A click opens a pop-up with all of that row's columns as label and value pairs.
nodes.visitors: A pop-up with the whole row, so they don't scroll sideways to read it. Esc, the × button or a click outside closes it.
facts: Row Details Popup: on or off, off by default
Skips empty and hidden columns
Opens with a click, Enter or Space
nodes.ux: Open a row's full details in a pop-up.

nodes.label: Export & Print
nodes.changes: Adds **CSV**, **Excel** and **Print** buttons to the table on your site. You choose which buttons, their labels and colors, and where they sit.
nodes.visitors: Buttons that download or print the rows they are currently viewing, so a search they ran is kept.
facts: Buttons: CSV, Excel (when Pro supports it), Print
Each button: Button Text, Background, Text
Position: After Search Box, Top Of The Table, Bottom Of The Table
Alignment: Left, Center, Right
nodes.ux: Let visitors download or print what they see.

branches.label: Beyond one table
branches.where: Gear icon › Settings, and the table's Custom CSS/JS tab
branches.goal: Reuse your design on every new table, or style what the panel does not cover.

nodes.label: Default design for new tables
nodes.changes: Sets the starting color, library, font, title, search, sorting and pagination of tables you create from now on. Tables you already have are never changed.
nodes.visitors: New tables that already look on-brand the moment they are created.
facts: Set in the gear icon › Settings › Global appearance
Affects new tables only; existing tables stay unchanged
nodes.ux: Start every new table already on-brand.

nodes.label: Custom CSS
nodes.changes: Adds your own styles for anything the panel does not cover.
nodes.visitors: A table styled beyond the built-in options.
facts: Add your own CSS or JS for anything the panel does not cover
nodes.ux: Style anything the panel can't reach.

branches.label: Row & cell colors
branches.goal: Color one row or one cell instead of the whole table.

nodes.label: Row & cell colors
nodes.changes: Colors a single row or cell.
facts: Row settings: color one row's background and text
Cell settings: color one cell; it wins over the row color
nodes.ux: Highlight one row or cell instead of the whole table.
